cond_0001.intro: The Client Finance Analyst I will assist in the overall financial management for our client portfolio, reporting, general day-to-day activities, and related month end close duties.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Assist with the overall monthly project accounting efforts including taking notes from the monthly status meetings with project managers and making project updates across financial trackers. Setup new projects awarded in time & expense systems and files including verifying signatures, agreeing to [Product name masked] and escalating discrepancies. Assist with updating project files for change orders, budget adjustments & carve outs, and updating project financial trackers for specific project milestones/tasks. Book intercompany revenue/cost transactions & update shared financial trackers. Assist with the preparation and investigation of hours and expenses for client projects incurred including review of assigned billing roles/rates. Prepare client invoicing based on contracts and follow up with customers on past due invoices. When applicable, create and maintain waterfall of invoicing per contracts. Assist in the preparation of monthly client accruals. Track project costs compared to contracted amounts as well as other direct costs shared across projects/clients. Assist in set up & tracking of new employees and when applicable subcontractor hours/bill rates/expenses monthly compared to forecast and budget. Update basic and routine monthly general ledger account reconciliations. Collaborate with SG&A team where applicable. Assist with ad hoc projects as applicable, including the annual budget preparation. Assist in pulling supporting documents for the annual audit.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree with a minimum concentration in accounting, finance or business
0-2 Years of relevant accounting/finance experience
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Month end close experience
Preferred Requirements
Revenue Recognition experience
Project Accounting experience
Client Services/Client Facing experience
Agency or Professional Services experience
Skills
Excellent client service including mutual respect and approach to communications as well as timeliness of responses
Deadline-oriented with good time management and organizational skills
Proven critical thinking, analytical, interpretative, and problem-solving skills
Ability to process and analyze large volumes of qualitative and quantitative information
Ability to multitask with great attention to detail, and high level of accountability
Display passion and purpose for what we do

Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills, and an ability to build credibility with external and internal stakeholders

Self-starting attitude with a strong desire to learn and grow rapidly

cond_0022.intro: The Client Finance Analyst I will assist in the overall financial management for our client portfolio, reporting, general day-to-day activities, and related month end close duties. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the financial and accounting logic behind client project work.
cond_0022.responsibilities:
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Assist with the overall monthly project accounting efforts including taking notes from the monthly status meetings with project managers and making project updates across financial trackers. Setup new projects awarded in time & expense systems and files including verifying signatures, agreeing to [Product name masked] and escalating discrepancies. Assist with updating project files for change orders, budget adjustments & carve outs, and updating project financial trackers for specific project milestones/tasks. Book intercompany revenue/cost transactions & update shared financial trackers. Assist with the preparation and investigation of hours and expenses for client projects incurred including review of assigned billing roles/rates. Prepare client invoicing based on contracts and follow up with customers on past due invoices. When applicable, create and maintain waterfall of invoicing per contracts. Assist in the preparation of monthly client accruals. Track project costs compared to contracted amounts as well as other direct costs shared across projects/clients. Assist in set up & tracking of new employees and when applicable subcontractor hours/bill rates/expenses monthly compared to forecast and budget. Update basic and routine monthly general ledger account reconciliations. Collaborate with SG&A team where applicable. Assist with ad hoc projects as applicable, including the annual budget preparation. Assist in pulling supporting documents for the annual audit.

Setup new projects awarded in time & expense systems and files including verifying signatures, agreeing to [Product name masked] and escalating discrepancies. Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Lead the overall monthly project accounting efforts, including capturing notes from monthly status meetings with project managers and executing project updates across financial trackers. Set up new projects awarded in time & expense systems and files, including verifying signatures, agreeing to [Product name masked], and escalating discrepancies. Drive updates to project files for change orders, budget adjustments & carve outs, and maintain project financial trackers for specific project milestones/tasks. Book intercompany revenue/cost transactions & manage shared financial trackers. Take ownership of the preparation and investigation of hours and expenses for client projects incurred, including review of assigned billing roles/rates. Prepare client invoicing based on contracts and follow up directly with customers on past due invoices. When applicable, build and maintain waterfall of invoicing per contracts. Execute preparation of monthly client accruals. Track project costs compared to contracted amounts as well as other direct costs shared across projects/clients. Set up & track new employees and, when applicable, subcontractor hours/bill rates/expenses monthly compared to forecast and budget. Maintain basic and routine monthly general ledger account reconciliations. Coordinate with SG&A team where applicable. Lead ad hoc projects as applicable, including the annual budget preparation. Pull supporting documents for the annual audit.
cond_0062.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree with a minimum concentration in accounting, finance, or business
0-2 Years of relevant accounting/finance experience
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Month end close experience
Preferred Requirements
Revenue Recognition experience
Project Accounting experience
Client Services/Client Facing experience
Agency or Professional Services experience
Skills
Excellent client service including mutual respect and approach to communications as well as timeliness of responses
Deadline-oriented with good time management and organizational skills

Support the setup of new projects in time & expense systems and files, including verifying signatures, agreeing to [Product name masked], and escalating discrepancies. cond_0601.intro: The Client Finance Analyst I will assist with financial management for our client portfolio, reporting, general day-to-day activities, and month end close duties.
cond_0601.responsibilities:
Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:
Assist with monthly project accounting efforts, including taking notes from status meetings with project managers and updating project financial trackers accordingly.
Set up new projects in time & expense systems and files, including verifying signatures, agreeing to [Product name masked], and escalating discrepancies.
Update project files for change orders, budget adjustments, and carve outs, and update project financial trackers for specific project milestones and tasks.
Book intercompany revenue and cost transactions and update shared financial trackers.
Assist with reviewing hours and expenses for client projects, including assigned billing roles and rates.
Prepare client invoicing based on contracts and follow up with customers on past due invoices. Where applicable, create and maintain a waterfall of invoicing per contracts.
Assist in the preparation of monthly client accruals.
Track project costs against contracted amounts and other direct costs shared across projects and clients.
Assist with setting up and tracking new employees and, where applicable, subcontractor hours, bill rates, and expenses monthly against forecast and budget.
Update basic and routine monthly general ledger account reconciliations.
Coordinate with the SG&A team where applicable.
Assist with ad hoc projects as applicable, including annual budget preparation.
Assist in pulling supporting documents for the annual audit.
